entries.name: Guide Depot
entries.summary: The in-game guide collects build recommendations for a selected Resonator.
body: Open Guide Depot from the Terminal and select a Resonator. Compare Echoes, weapons, upgrade priorities and teammates; some characters have multiple guides.
Choose recommendations that match your owned equipment and intended role. The official announcement warns that guide data may refresh late, so check the guide’s assumptions before spending materials.

entries.name: Echo presets and comparison
entries.summary: Save a named setup before experimenting with another Echo lineup.
body: In Echo Assembly, save the current setup as a preset. Select another preset and expand attribute comparison before applying it.
Name setups by their purpose, such as exploration or a particular team. Compare the complete setup rather than one attractive stat on a single Echo.

entries.name: Echo management rules
entries.summary: Automatic rules can protect matching drops or mark them for discard.
body: Open Data Bank → Data Merge → Echo Management. Rules can consider quality, COST, Sonata Effect and main stat; several plans may be active.
Test a narrow auto-lock rule on a new drop before adding discard rules. Review all active plans and their results before processing your collection.

entries.name: Terminal synthesis
entries.summary: Purification and Conversion solve different material shortages.
body: Terminal Synthesis offers Purification across material rarities and Conversion for supported materials within the same category and rarity.
Open the intended upgrade first, record the missing item and quantity, then inspect the recipe output before confirming. Do not convert ingredients needed for another planned upgrade.

entries.name: Region Guide
entries.summary: The map’s Region Guide helps find regional features and their unlock conditions.
body: Open the Region Guide from the map. Select an unlocked feature to navigate to it, or read the requirement shown for a locked feature.
Use this before searching random map icons for a missing activity. A visible region or feature does not mean its prerequisites have already been completed.

entries.name: Resonator Skill Training
entries.summary: A character tutorial helps connect inputs to the Resonator’s combat sequence.
body: Find Skill Training under Guidebook → Path of Growth and select the relevant Resonator. Follow the demonstrated sequence before testing it in a familiar encounter.
Practice one unclear transition at a time. Equipment recommendations alone do not teach when to switch characters or which input a skill requires.

entries.name: Ascension collection spots
entries.summary: Material tracking starts from the item you actually need.
body: Select an Ascension Material in Backpack or the Resonators page, then choose Collection Spots. After exhausting the tracked location, the next location becomes available for tracking.
Set a target quantity before leaving and check it after each stop. This is a gathering aid, not evidence that a resource has instantly respawned.

entries.name: Flight in Jinzhou and the Black Shores
entries.summary: Flight access in these regions depends on the Windrider Project tutorials.
body: Complete the required Flight tutorials before using the utility in Jinzhou or the Black Shores. Some areas near water or map boundaries switch Flight to Glide.
Test a short route after unlocking it and watch the current utility indicator. Do not plan a long crossing on the assumption that Flight works everywhere.
